title: Understanding Sui Part 2: Ownership and Capability Checks

reader_steps.label: terminal-one
reader_steps.command:
mkdir -p sui-ownership
cd sui-ownership
mkdir -p .local/network move/sources move/tests client evidence
export SUI_CONFIG_DIR="$PWD/.local/network"
export MOVE_HOME="$PWD/.local/move-cache"
sui genesis --working-dir "$SUI_CONFIG_DIR" --with-faucet --committee-size 1 --epoch-duration-ms 86400000
sui start --network.config "$SUI_CONFIG_DIR" --with-faucet --fullnode-rpc-port 9000
reader_steps.note: The genesis command is silent on success. The final command is a long-running local server. Keep this terminal open. Its startup log varies; the next commands verify readiness.

reader_steps.label: terminal-two
reader_steps.command:
cd sui-ownership
export SUI_CONFIG_DIR="$PWD/.local/network"
export MOVE_HOME="$PWD/.local/move-cache"
sui client addresses --json > evidence/addresses.json
ALICE=$(python3 -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("evidence/addresses.json"))["addresses"][0][1])')
BOB=$(python3 -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("evidence/addresses.json"))["addresses"][1][1])')
CHAIN_ID=$(sui client chain-identifier --json | python3 -c 'import json, sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["base58"])')
printf 'ALICE=%s\nBOB=%s\nCHAIN_ID=%s\n' "$ALICE" "$BOB" "$CHAIN_ID"

reader_steps.label: manifest
reader_steps.command:
cat > move/Move.toml <<TOML
[package]
name = "sui_ownership"
edition = "2024"

[environments]
localnet = "$CHAIN_ID"
TOML
reader_steps.note: The shell substitutes CHAIN_ID obtained above. The value differs after a new genesis.

reader_steps.test_scope: Two inventory rejections are Move test_scenario behavior, not public-node authorization. A separate expected code0 test exercises set_value’s guard.

reader_steps.label: publish
reader_steps.command:
sui client publish move --sender "$ALICE" --gas-budget 100000000 --json > evidence/publish.json
PACKAGE_ID=$(python3 -c 'import json; d=json.load(open("evidence/publish.json")); print(next(o["packageId"] for o in d["objectChanges"] if o["type"] == "published"))')
printf 'PACKAGE_ID=%s\n' "$PACKAGE_ID"

reader_steps.label: create
reader_steps.command:
sui client call --package "$PACKAGE_ID" --module notebook --function create_owned --args 7 --sender "$ALICE" --gas-budget 50000000 --json > evidence/create.json
NOTE_ID=$(python3 -c 'import json; d=json.load(open("evidence/create.json")); print(next(o["objectId"] for o in d["objectChanges"] if o["type"] == "created" and o["objectType"].endswith("::notebook::Notebook")))')
CAP_ID=$(python3 -c 'import json; d=json.load(open("evidence/create.json")); print(next(o["objectId"] for o in d["objectChanges"] if o["type"] == "created" and o["objectType"].endswith("::notebook::NotebookCap")))')
printf 'NOTE_ID=%s\nCAP_ID=%s\n' "$NOTE_ID" "$CAP_ID"

reader_steps.label: alice-update
reader_steps.command:
sui client call --package "$PACKAGE_ID" --module notebook --function set_value --args "$NOTE_ID" "$CAP_ID" 9 --sender "$ALICE" --gas-budget 50000000 --json > evidence/alice-update.json
python3 -c 'import json; d=json.load(open("evidence/alice-update.json")); print("Status:", d["effects"]["status"]["status"]); print("Digest:", d["digest"])'
reader_steps.output_kind: Exact projection from retained complete CLI JSON

reader_steps.label: transfer-notebook
reader_steps.command:
sui client transfer --to "$BOB" --object-id "$NOTE_ID" --sender "$ALICE" --gas-budget 50000000 --json > evidence/transfer-notebook.json
python3 -c 'import json; d=json.load(open("evidence/transfer-notebook.json")); print("Status:", d["effects"]["status"]["status"]); print("Digest:", d["digest"])'
reader_steps.output_kind: Exact projection from retained complete CLI JSON

reader_steps.label: choose-gas
reader_steps.command:
sui client gas "$ALICE" --json > evidence/alice-gas.json
sui client gas "$BOB" --json > evidence/bob-gas.json
ALICE_GAS=$(python3 -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("evidence/alice-gas.json"))["gasCoins"][0]["gasCoinId"])')
BOB_GAS=$(python3 -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("evidence/bob-gas.json"))["gasCoins"][0]["gasCoinId"])')
printf 'ALICE_GAS=%s\nBOB_GAS=%s\n' "$ALICE_GAS" "$BOB_GAS"
reader_steps.note: Explicit gas coins and budgets avoid the automatic gas-selection simulation becoming the first rejection boundary.

reader_steps.label: bob-rejected
reader_steps.command:
sui client call --package "$PACKAGE_ID" --module notebook --function set_value --args "$NOTE_ID" "$CAP_ID" 10 --sender "$BOB" --gas "$BOB_GAS" --gas-budget 50000000 --json > evidence/bob-rejected.txt 2>&1
printf 'Exit code: %s\n' "$?"
sed -n '/^    0: RPC error:/p' evidence/bob-rejected.txt

actor_note: Unit tests use ALICE @0xA and BOB @0xB as test_scenario fixtures. CLI accounts are newly generated prefunded local genesis addresses; the same role labels do not imply equal literal addresses.
cache_note: Copied prior official framework cache; no fresh network download claim. Fresh package with no lockfile compiled correctly and generated its own localnet lock.
environment_note: genesis and node used author-specific paths, while displayed commands use new project sui-ownership. Absolute configuration paths avoid relative keystore errors.

boundaries.signed_node_rejections: InvalidArgument ordinary input-owner checks with explicit gas and budget
boundaries.unsigned_bytes: Optional public audit material; after handover old references are stale.

privacy_note: Never copy .local or .private. They contain disposable local keys. All evidence/ receipts are public local transaction data. No original wallet, public-funded wallet, mainnet operation, or paid transaction was used.
reference_note: Unpublished author reference. Reader commands retain the original fresh-directory workflow. Recorded output paths and the network-specific Move.toml source path were remapped into recorded-cli. Use move/Move.toml.template with a freshly obtained CHAIN_ID to run on a new localnet. Raw optional unsigned-transaction BCS was excluded.
